$comment: The app member kind (#3151, ws-093). A workspace pins a copy of this directory by path, as the reference workspace does at kinds/app, and chant reads it as data. The fields are the conventions an orchestrator relies on to run, migrate, test and check an app: the scripts in its package.json, the environment variables it reads, and the path it answers health on. The canonical copy ships in @intentius/chant at src/workspace/reference-kinds/app.

kinds.name: app
kinds.description: an app: a Node package with a start script in the package.json directly in its directory

scripts.description: Which package.json script plays each part, run with npm run from the member's directory

start.description: Runs a release of the app; it listens on the port env.port names

test.description: The app's own tests, run before a release

migrate.description: Applies the app's migrations to the data directory env.data names; a missing script means there are none

env.description: The environment variables the app reads, by name

port.description: The port the app listens on

data.description: The directory the app keeps its data in

revision.description: The revision the running app reports, such as the release's commit

health.description: The path the running app answers on with a status below 500 once it is up
